newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Excel Economico 1996 net 23.3 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Excel Economico 1996 net 23.3 mln reais.

text.p: Brazilian Excel Economico bank posted a 1996 net profit of 23.3 million reais due to a 140 percent increase in the number of customers, the bank said in a statement.

The bank said 1996 results reflected only eight months of business, because the bank started operating on May 2, after private bank Excel Banco acquired selected assets and liabilities of failed Banco Economico.
"The bank's strategy to become one of the main Brazilian retail banks has already shown some positive results," the statement said.

The number of current account and savings account holders increased to 720,000 at the end of 1996 from 300,000 in May mostly because of new banking products such as credit cards and pension plans and opening of new branches throughout the country, it said.
Second-half earnings of 28.3 million reais led to a 10.96 percent annual return on equity. The bank's net worth at the end of 1996 was 530 million reais.
Checking account deposits in the second half of 1996 totalled 223.1 million reais, a rise of 17 percent, it said.
Assets at Excel Economico's investment funds jumped 131.5 percent to 526.4 million reais in December 1996 from 223.1 million reais in June last year, it said.
Lending operations also rose 57 percent in the second half 1996, it added.
